graph.title: LEGO Mixels Seismo (41504-1)
notes: Piece count: 50 = 22 body/arm pieces + 28 leg pieces (verified against the parts list). Arms (6 pieces) are in the repeat; the two legs are written out because their colours differ.
Stud/anti-stud port numbers are approximate: the pictures do not show which studs are used, so several joins use null ports or representative ports.

Assumed layout of the body: the 4 black clip plates sit on the round plate b1, the 2 towball-socket plates sit on b2, and the round brick b9 goes on top of all of them. Two clips carry the horns and two carry the arm handles.
The black inverted slope (lego-3049d) is not shown in the step-6 parts box. I assumed it is added to the body top at step 6 next to the curved wing piece, and joined it to b9.
Cheese-slope colours in the legs are inferred from the totals (3 gold, 3 light grey). Leg 1: two grey and one gold on the knee piece. Leg 2: gold on top, grey on the side, gold on the knee piece.
In the arm, the curved brick is joined only to the handle plate stud; the exact stud use is unclear from the picture.
Leg ball/socket joins: 14417 ball into the 14419 socket (foot to knee), then the 14419 ball into the body socket plates b7 and b8.
